squawks.headline: US Treasury sanctions 4 India-based individuals and 9 companies for supporting Iran's shadow fleet
squawks.detail: The US Treasury says the 4 individuals and 9 companies, all based in India, are being sanctioned for supporting Iran's shadow fleet. It is part of the Iran sanctions action announced earlier today, which also included a warning that falsely flagged vessels have no valid protection or insurance.

squawks.headline: US Treasury's OFAC warns industry about vessels that may be falsely flagged and names a Turkey-based firm in Iran sanctions
squawks.detail: As part of its latest Iran-related sanctions, the US Treasury designated Turkey-based Fugo Ground Services for supporting Iran's aviation sector. Its Office of Foreign Assets Control also issued a new alert to industry on the risks of dealing with vessels that may be falsely flagged.

squawks.headline: Brent crude slides 10% to near $93 a barrel, its lowest in two months
squawks.detail: Brent crude is reported down 10% at close to $93 a barrel, its lowest level in two months, as the oil sell-off extends through the session.

squawks.headline: OBR's David Miles names fiscal drag as one of three main causes of near-stagnant UK household income growth this decade
squawks.detail: David Miles of the Office for Budget Responsibility said frozen income tax thresholds, which pull more people into higher tax bands, are one of three main reasons that growth in UK households' disposable income is close to stagnant in the current decade, City A.M. reports.

squawks.headline: US Treasury advisory committee finds AI-linked corporate borrowing is not crowding out demand for Treasuries
squawks.detail: The Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee reached this view at its latest meeting, Reuters reports. The committee also cautioned that the AI financing boom is still at an early stage.

squawks.headline: US Treasury announces new sanctions related to Iran
squawks.detail: The US Treasury Department posted new Iran-related sanctions on its website. No further details were given in the report.

squawks.headline: House Democratic leader Jeffries says Democrats will pass a bill to stop Trump's tariffs and end the Iran war
squawks.detail: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries made the pledge after the Democrats won control of Congress in the midterms. He also said he had not heard from Trump.

squawks.headline: Brent crude falls to $95 a barrel, down 10% from Friday
squawks.detail: An economist reports that Brent crude is at $95 a barrel, 10% lower than on Friday, as the slide following the US midterm results continues.

squawks.headline: Brent crude futures extend their slide to more than $7 a barrel; US crude falls more than $5 to near $90
squawks.detail: Market reports show Brent crude futures down by more than $7 a barrel and US crude futures down by more than $5 a barrel. US crude is reported trading near $90 a barrel as the oil sell-off deepens.

squawks.headline: European gas prices fall by as much as 5.3% to €86.74/MWh
squawks.detail: European gas prices fell by as much as 5.3% to €86.74 per megawatt hour on Wednesday, according to a market report.

squawks.headline: Canada says the US midterm results will not change its position in trade talks with the US
squawks.detail: According to Reuters, a senior Canadian cabinet minister said on Wednesday that Ottawa's stance on trade talks with the US is unchanged after the midterms. He added that he expects to speak to his US counterparts soon.

squawks.headline: UK 10-year gilt yield drops 12bp to 5.143%, its lowest since 4 September
squawks.detail: The 10-year gilt yield was reported down 12bp at 5.143%, its lowest level since 4 September. This extends the earlier fall that took it 5bp lower to 5.21%.

squawks.headline: Swiss Federal Council adopts the EU's 21st package of sanctions on Russia
squawks.detail: Switzerland's Federal Council has adopted the EU's 21st Russia sanctions package.

squawks.headline: Brent crude futures extend their slide to more than $5 a barrel
squawks.detail: Market reports say Brent crude futures are now down more than $5 a barrel on the day. Earlier in the session the fall was more than $4.

squawks.headline: Brent and US crude futures extend their slide to more than $4 a barrel
squawks.detail: Market reports at 16:07 GMT show Brent and US crude futures each down by more than $4 a barrel on the day. Earlier in the session the losses were above $2.

squawks.headline: France's 10-year government bond yield extends its fall, down 12.5bp at 4.80%
squawks.detail: A market newswire reports that France's 10-year government bond yield fell further, to 4.80%, a drop of 12.5bp on the day.

squawks.headline: Brent crude drops below $100 a barrel for the first time since 7 October
squawks.detail: Brent crude futures fell below $100 a barrel, the first time since 7 October, according to market reports. The fall extends the oil price losses that followed the US midterm results.

squawks.headline: US Vice President Vance says the war was the reason Republicans lost the midterms, and the Israel relationship was another
squawks.detail: Vance said the war was the main reason for the Republican defeat in the US midterm elections and named the relationship with Israel as a further reason. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Canada's trade surplus widens to C$5.35bn in September, its highest since May 2022
squawks.detail: Canadian data released on Wednesday show the September trade surplus at C$5.35 billion ($3.83 billion), Reuters reports. Gold and higher energy exports, mainly to the United States, drove the rise.

squawks.headline: US ISM services PMI eases to 54.5 in October, just below the 54.8 forecast; prices paid falls to 73
squawks.detail: The ISM services index came in at 54.5, down from 54.9 and below the 54.8 forecast. Prices paid fell to 73 from 74.0 (74.6 forecast), new orders dropped to 55.9 from 59.8 (58.5 forecast) and employment rose to 51.4 from 50.1 (50 forecast).

squawks.headline: UK new car sales rise 26.9% y/y in October to 154,407 units
squawks.detail: Figures from New AutoMotive put total UK new car sales in October at 154,407 units, an increase of 26.9% on a year earlier.

squawks.headline: US final October S&P Global services PMI is revised down to 56.1 from a 57.9 flash
squawks.detail: S&P Global's final October US services PMI came in at 56.1, against a forecast and flash reading of 57.9 and 58.8 in September. The composite PMI is 55.9, down from a 57.6 flash and 58.4 in September.

squawks.headline: US final October S&P Global composite PMI falls to 55.9, below the 57.3 forecast and down from 57.6
squawks.detail: S&P Global's final US composite PMI for October came in at 55.9, against a forecast of 57.3 and a previous reading of 57.6.

squawks.headline: EU foreign policy chief Kallas hopes the new US Congress keeps backing Ukraine and keeps up pressure on Russia
squawks.detail: Responding to the US midterm results, EU foreign policy chief Kallas said US voters had made a clear choice. She said she hoped the new Congress and Senate would keep supporting Ukraine and add pressure on Russia.

squawks.headline: Turkey's parliament is due to ratify a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan that includes a collective defence clause
squawks.detail: Reuters reports that Turkey's parliament is set to ratify the pact on Wednesday, which would commit Turkish forces to Saudi Arabia's defence while the kingdom faces attacks from Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis.

squawks.headline: WTI crude falls 3% to $93.25 a barrel
squawks.detail: US WTI crude futures are reported down 3% at $93.25 a barrel, adding to the day's earlier oil price losses.

squawks.headline: Houthis say they fired a ballistic missile at Riyadh's King Khalid airport; Saudi Arabia has not confirmed
squawks.detail: A Houthi spokesperson in Yemen says the group launched a ballistic missile at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and urges international airlines not to fly over Saudi airspace. There is no Saudi confirmation.

squawks.headline: UK October PMI shows input cost inflation picking up again, with composite output at its strongest since February
squawks.detail: Details of the S&P Global UK PMI survey for October show input cost inflation rising again and the employment component positive for the first time since the first Budget of Chancellor Reeves. The composite output index was at its highest level since February.

squawks.headline: Iran's Larijani rules out talks with the US on war or peace and says Tehran has chosen to keep resisting
squawks.detail: Iranian reports say Larijani described the choice facing Iran in its stand-off with Washington as one between giving in and resisting, and said Iran will go on resisting. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: US Treasury sets quarterly refunding at $125bn, in line with estimates, and changes its guidance on future auction sizes
squawks.detail: The US Treasury set the 3-year note auction at $58bn, the 10-year note at $42bn and the 30-year bond at $25bn, and changed its guidance on future changes to auction sizes.

squawks.headline: Brent and US crude futures extend losses, down more than $2 a barrel
squawks.detail: Brent and US crude futures are reported down more than $2 a barrel as the decline extends.

squawks.headline: US trade deficit narrows to $105bn in September, smaller than the $107.9bn forecast
squawks.detail: US data put the September trade balance at -$105bn, against a forecast of -$107.9bn. The previous month's figure was revised to -$105.7bn from -$105.6bn.

squawks.headline: US ADP private payrolls rise 86,000 in October, beating the 67,000 forecast
squawks.detail: ADP data show US private employment up 86,000 in October, against a forecast of 67,000 and a previous reading of 90,000. Spot gold was reported little changed after the release.

squawks.headline: UK prime minister's spokesperson says de-escalation in the Middle East is the priority
squawks.detail: The prime minister's spokesperson said the government's priority is de-escalation in the Middle East. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: ECB's Knot says the ECB would respond with a somewhat hawkish policy as core inflation and second-round effects pick up
squawks.detail: Knot, a candidate for an ECB post, said the central bank would meet the expected rise in core inflation and second-round effects with a somewhat hawkish policy stance.

squawks.headline: ECB's Knot says AI will lift productivity growth and that Europe is caught up in the US-China rivalry
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Knot made the remarks in further comments on 4 November. He did not give any new figures or guidance on rates.

squawks.headline: ECB's Knot expects core inflation and second-round effects to pick up, says ECB may more often approach 2% from above
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Knot said core inflation and second-round effects are likely to rise and that small shocks lifting inflation will keep occurring. He said the ECB may more often have to approach its 2% target from above.

squawks.headline: Brent is reported at $102, down from $118 at the end of last week, after the US midterm results
squawks.detail: An economist puts Brent crude at $102 a barrel, against $118 at the end of last week, and says the oil market's direction depends on whether the US eases or steps up the war with Iran after the midterms.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation says Budget plans cut departmental capital spending in 2029-30 compared with the March forecast
squawks.detail: The Resolution Foundation says the Budget again scaled back planned investment, leaving capital departmental spending lower in 2029-30 than in the March forecast. Defence investment is the exception.

squawks.headline: EU trade commissioner Sefcovic says it is vital that the US-EU trade deal is upheld
squawks.detail: EU Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic said that respecting the trade agreement between the US and the EU is of the highest importance. The remarks follow the Democrats' wins in the US midterm elections.

squawks.headline: Kremlin hopes the US midterm results will not affect Trump's peace efforts on Ukraine
squawks.detail: The Kremlin made the comment after Democrats won control of Congress, and Tass also reported that Russia hopes Trump will continue his peace efforts.

squawks.headline: France's finance minister Lescure sees no reason to revise the 5.4% 2026 deficit goal
squawks.detail: Lescure also said France has to meet its 5% deficit target for 2027 if it is to remain credible.

squawks.headline: S&P Global survey shows UK businesses adding staff for the first time in more than two years
squawks.detail: City AM reports that S&P Global's survey figures showed headcount rising for the first time in over two years, alongside stronger services activity. Analysts cited by the paper expect the Bank of England to raise rates several times in the coming months.

squawks.headline: Chancellor Healey confirms a further 2% rise in tax on savings income from April 2027
squawks.detail: City AM reports the Budget measure takes the savings tax rate to 44% for some, and that thousands of workers will face an effective rate of 64% on cash savings.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation says typical UK household energy bills this year are close to their level in the 2022 energy shock
squawks.detail: The Resolution Foundation estimates that the typical household will spend nearly as much on energy this year as it did during the 2022 shock. The think tank gave no figures in the post.

squawks.headline: Khamenei calls Iran's Hormuz action a response to US aggression and says the US midterm result will not change Washington's hostility
squawks.detail: In a message, Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei said the US wants Iran's unconditional surrender and that any move towards submission would embolden the enemy. He said people who expect changes in the party holding power in the US to end Washington's hostility towards Iran are badly mistaken.

squawks.headline: Iran's Khamenei warns that any further attacks will bring a far wider response
squawks.detail: In a message, Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei said Iran must become ever more powerful to achieve absolute deterrence, and warned that further attacks would draw a far wider response. Separately, an IRGC adviser told Tasnim that in a war, Iran's retaliation would not be limited to the source of the attack.

squawks.headline: Germany's 15-year Bund auction yields 3.57%, up from 3.5%, with bid-to-cover falling to 1.3 from 2
squawks.detail: Germany sold 15-year Bunds at an average yield of 3.57%, compared with 3.5% at the previous sale. The bid-to-cover ratio was 1.3, down from 2 last time.

squawks.headline: Gilts extend gains as the 10-year yield falls 5bp to 5.21%
squawks.detail: UK government bonds add to earlier gains on Wednesday morning, with the 10-year gilt yield down 5bp at 5.21%, according to a market report.

squawks.headline: Eurozone flash October inflation rises to 4% y/y, in line with forecasts; core inflation holds at 2.5%
squawks.detail: Eurozone flash headline CPI came in at 4% year on year, up from 3.8% and matching the 4% forecast. Core CPI was 2.5%, unchanged and in line with expectations, and prices rose 0.4% month on month, down from 0.6% and in line with the forecast.

squawks.headline: NIESR expects the MPC to raise Bank Rate by 25bp to 4% at tomorrow's decision
squawks.detail: NIESR said its Monetary Policy Dashboard shows a growing case for a change in policy, and that it expects a 25bp increase to 4% at the MPC decision on 5 November.

squawks.headline: UK final October composite PMI is revised down to 52.9 from a 53.1 flash, below the 53.1 forecast
squawks.detail: The final October composite PMI came in at 52.9, below the preliminary reading and forecast of 53.1. The services PMI was revised down to 52.8 from 53.1.

squawks.headline: UK final October services PMI is revised down to 52.8, against a 53.1 forecast and earlier reading
squawks.detail: The UK's final services PMI came in at 52.8. Forecasts and the previous reading were both 53.1.

squawks.headline: Gold rises 3% as the dollar and yields fall after Democrats win the US midterms
squawks.detail: A market wire reports gold up 3%, with the dollar and yields lower after the Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterm elections.

squawks.headline: ECB projects wage growth of 2.8% in the second quarter of 2027, slowing to 2.4% in the third quarter
squawks.detail: The European Central Bank's latest wage projections put wage growth at 2.8% in 2Q 2027 and 2.4% in 3Q 2027.

squawks.headline: Eurozone final October services PMI is revised down to 51.4 from 51.7; composite PMI cut to 51.7
squawks.detail: The eurozone's final October services PMI was 51.4, below the 51.7 flash reading and forecast. The composite PMI came in at 51.7, against a flash reading and forecast of 51.9.

squawks.headline: Germany's final October services PMI is revised up to 52.5 from a 51.7 flash; composite PMI rises to 53.4
squawks.detail: Germany's final October services PMI came in at 52.5, compared with a 51.7 flash reading and forecast. The composite PMI was 53.4, up from a preliminary 52.8 and above the 52.8 forecast.

squawks.headline: France's final October services PMI is revised down to 46.2 from a 48.4 flash; composite PMI cut to 46.6
squawks.detail: France's final October services PMI came in at 46.2, against a forecast and flash reading of 48.4. The composite PMI was 46.6, also against a forecast and preliminary reading of 48.4.

squawks.headline: Italy's October composite PMI eases to 50.8, in line with forecasts
squawks.detail: Italy's composite PMI fell to 50.8 in October from 51.0 in September, matching the 50.8 forecast. The services PMI rose to 52.

squawks.headline: Italy's services PMI rises to 52 in October, above the 51.5 forecast
squawks.detail: Italy's services PMI came in at 52, up from 51.7 previously and ahead of the 51.5 forecast.

squawks.headline: Asian markets fall sharply as Democratic midterm gains raise fears of AI regulation
squawks.detail: Asian markets were reported plunging on Wednesday morning after Democratic gains in the US midterm elections, with the drop linked to fears of tighter regulation of artificial intelligence. No index levels or figures were given.

squawks.headline: Japan's deputy chief cabinet secretary Kihara says Tokyo is watching market moves with a high sense of urgency
squawks.detail: Japan's Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Kihara said markets move on various factors and that the government is monitoring market moves with a high sense of urgency.

squawks.headline: Japan's 10-year government bond yield rises 4bp to 2.81%
squawks.detail: Japan's 10-year yield gained 4bp to 2.81% in Asian trading, while the Nikkei was still down 1.65% after coming back from its session lows.

squawks.headline: Trump links Republican midterm losses partly to the Iran war and petrol prices but says he does not regret starting it
squawks.detail: Trump said voters were probably not willing to bear the short-term cost of higher petrol prices tied to Iran. The WSJ reports he accepted that the war was one reason for Republican losses but said he does not regret starting the conflict earlier this year.

squawks.headline: India's October services PMI is revised down to 55.8 from a 56.2 flash; composite PMI falls to 56.2
squawks.detail: The final HSBC/S&P Global services PMI for India came in at 55.8 for October, below the flash reading of 56.2. The composite PMI fell to 56.2 from 56.7 the previous month.

squawks.headline: Democrats win control of US Senate and House in midterms; global stocks and the dollar slide
squawks.detail: Media projections show Democrats flipping Senate seats in Texas, Ohio, North Carolina, South Carolina and Georgia, and enough Republican-held seats to take the House. The FT and WSJ report that global stocks and the dollar fell on the results, and the WSJ says a weaker dollar and lower US bond yields lifted demand for gold.

squawks.headline: Iran's IRGC says four tankers are destroyed by naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and two more ships are seized
squawks.detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said the four oil tankers hit mines while using a route it calls prohibited south of the strait and were still on fire, and that two other vessels had been detained.

squawks.headline: US 2-year Treasury yield falls to two-month low of 4.551% as fed funds futures extend gains
squawks.detail: The US 2-year yield dropped to 4.551% in Asian trading while fed funds futures rose further. The move came as US networks including CNN and NBC projected that Democrats would win control of the House in the midterm elections, and the euro rose 0.5% to $1.125.

squawks.headline: China's October services PMI drops to 50.8, below the 51.7 forecast; composite PMI eases to 52.0
squawks.detail: China's RatingDog services PMI fell to 50.8 in October from 51.6 in September, against a forecast of 51.7. The composite PMI fell to 52.0 from 52.4.

squawks.headline: US 2-year Treasury yield falls 6bp to 4.573% in Asian trading as fed funds futures edge higher
squawks.detail: Market reports say the US 2-year yield fell 6bp to 4.573%, while fed funds futures posted modest gains.

squawks.headline: PBOC steps up re-lending support for stock buybacks as applications pass 200bn yuan
squawks.detail: China's central bank said it is expanding re-lending policies that support share buybacks and increased holdings, with applications above 200bn yuan. Separately, it injected 257.5bn yuan through overnight reverse repos at 1.25%.

squawks.headline: Australia's household spending rises 0.6% m/m in September, with volumes up 0.7% q/q
squawks.detail: Australian data showed seasonally adjusted household spending up 0.6% on the month in September and spending volumes up 0.7% on the quarter.

squawks.headline: US Treasury yields ease in Asian trading; 10-year down 5bp at 4.9167% and 30-year at 5.2964%
squawks.detail: US Treasury yields moved lower early in the Asian session as US midterm election results came in.

squawks.headline: Trump tells the FT the US has no immediate plan to strike Iran and describes the stand-off with Tehran as brilliant
squawks.detail: In an interview with the Financial Times hours before the midterm polls closed, the US president said he was content with the stand-off with Iran but signalled he was ready for more war if needed.

squawks.headline: Canada's Carney says the US is asking for fewer concessions and offering more, and some Canadian red lines have been dropped
squawks.detail: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said some of Canada's limits in the US trade talks have been removed and discussions will intensify, though no deal has been reached yet. He added that lines of communication remain open even when negotiators are not meeting the USTR.

squawks.headline: Canada's Carney says trade talks with the US have made progress but are not finished, with red lines still to be resolved
squawks.detail: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said negotiations with the US will become more intensive, and that key issues and some red lines still have to be addressed. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Australia's final services PMI rises to 48.5 from 47.8 and the composite PMI to 48.2 from 47.7
squawks.detail: Australia's final October services PMI came in at 48.5, up from 47.8.

squawks.headline: New Zealand unemployment rises to 5.7%, above the 5.5% forecast, as employment falls 0.1% q/q
squawks.detail: New Zealand's unemployment rate was 5.7%, against a 5.5% forecast and 5.6% previously. Employment fell 0.1% q/q, against a forecast rise of 0.4% and 0.5% previously, and the participation rate fell to 70.4% from 70.7%, below the 70.7% forecast.

squawks.headline: ECB's Kocher says a December rate hike is likely unless the situation changes and inflation risks are still elevated
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Martin Kocher said risks to inflation are still elevated and that the ECB will keep responding to inflation where needed. He said a rate hike in December is likely if conditions do not change.

squawks.headline: Iran's Araghchi says Tehran will not give up its independence under economic pressure and says the US misreads Iran's leadership
squawks.detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi made the comments in an interview with Al Jazeera, while mediated US-Iran talks continue.

squawks.headline: ECB's Sleijpen says France's problems have to be resolved by Paris
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Sleijpen said France's problems need to be solved in Paris. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: ECB's Nagel says he is confident France will sort out its budget problems and that this is not a job for monetary policy
squawks.detail: Bundesbank President and ECB Governing Council member Joachim Nagel commented on France's fiscal position on 3 November. He said dealing with the budget is not a task for monetary policy.

squawks.headline: ECB's Sleijpen sees no clear second-round inflation effects yet but says tightening is slowing Europe's economy
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Sleijpen said second-round effects are not yet really visible, that rising energy risks carry knock-on effects for inflation, and that policy tightening is slowing the European economy.

squawks.headline: ECB's Sleijpen says the Iran shock is proving more persistent than previously thought
squawks.detail: Olaf Sleijpen, Dutch central bank governor and ECB Governing Council member, said the shock from the Iran war is lasting longer than earlier expected.

squawks.headline: Greenland's parliament ratifies security deal with the US that allows a larger US military presence on the island
squawks.detail: Reuters reports that Greenland's parliament ratified on Tuesday the security agreement signed by US President Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark, which may resolve the standoff over the island. Some opposition members questioned the deal.

squawks.headline: ECB's Nagel says a December rate hike is very likely needed as inflation pressures near the adverse scenario
squawks.detail: Bundesbank President and ECB Governing Council member Joachim Nagel said September inflation pressures were higher than expected and approaching the ECB's adverse scenario. He said the ECB must stop the energy price spike from feeding into broad-based inflation.

squawks.headline: Israel tells the US that Iran is considering chemical weapons use, NYT reports, and US officials are divided on the claim
squawks.detail: The New York Times, citing US and regional officials, reports that Israel has shared intelligence with the US asserting that Iran is weighing the use of chemical weapons against its adversaries. Some US officials reacted with alarm and others with deep scepticism, and some see it as part of an Israeli push for the US to return to major combat operations against Iran.

squawks.headline: Russia's foreign ministry says it will seek removal of sanctions on Russian assets in Norway and invokes the Svalbard Treaty
squawks.detail: Russian reports cite the foreign ministry as saying Moscow will try to have the sanctions on Russian assets in Norway lifted. The ministry also demands that Oslo comply fully with international law, including the Svalbard Treaty.

squawks.headline: Russia summons Norway's chargé d'affaires to protest over the seizure of Russian assets requested by Ukraine
squawks.detail: Russian reports say the foreign ministry lodged a protest with Norway's chargé d'affaires after Russian assets were seized following a request from Ukraine.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Russia would not survive fully enforced sanctions and urges pressure rather than dialogue alone with Putin
squawks.detail: Ukraine's president said Russia could not survive if all sanctions were fully applied with no exemptions for some oligarchs. He also said Putin responds to pressure and strong steps, and that Europe is several times stronger than Russia.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation says Budget headroom fell from £24bn to £15bn as energy prices top the OBR's central forecast
squawks.detail: The Resolution Foundation says oil and gas prices have gone above the OBR's central forecast since its forecast window closed in mid-August, and are nearer its severe scenario. It says gilt yields are still in line with the OBR's central forecast.

squawks.headline: Iranian official says mediators are working to close the gap between Tehran and Washington
squawks.detail: An Iranian official said mediators are trying to narrow the differences between Iran and the US as talks on a possible deal go on. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: BoC's Macklem says he does not see fiscal policy currently making it harder to bring inflation down
squawks.detail: Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said that, in present circumstances, he does not believe fiscal policy is complicating efforts to lower inflation. He made the remark after earlier saying further rate hikes may be needed.

squawks.headline: Senior Iranian official says there is no deadline for exchanging messages with the US through mediators or reviewing responses
squawks.detail: The comment was reported on Tuesday as Qatari-mediated US-Iran talks continue.

squawks.headline: BoC's Macklem says the inflation outlook has worsened and further rate hikes may be needed, with decisions taken meeting by meeting
squawks.detail: The Bank of Canada Governor said higher oil prices linked to the Middle East war are lifting costs, and CPI inflation is expected to rise to 3.5% by year-end, stay at or above 3% through much of 2027 and return near 2% by mid-2028. He put Q2 GDP growth at 3.3% and Q3 at around 2%, and projected growth of 1% in 2026 and about 2% in both 2027 and 2028, with a Q4 slowdown due to new US tariffs.

squawks.headline: Gulf oil exports fall in October from September, their highest level since the Iran war began, ship-tracking data show
squawks.detail: Reuters cites data from two ship-tracking companies showing Gulf oil exports fell in October from September's levels. Both companies said the October figures could be revised up as more shipment details come in.

squawks.headline: Iran denies reports that it is close to a deal with the US, state broadcaster IRIB says
squawks.detail: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB reports that Tehran rejects reports of a near agreement with the US. The denial follows earlier reports of US and Iranian concessions on the nuclear programme and frozen funds.

squawks.headline: Iran's negotiating team says no new progress has been made towards an agreement with the US
squawks.detail: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB quotes the spokesman for Iran's negotiating team as saying there has been no new development on an agreement with the US. The statement follows earlier reports of concessions by both sides on Tehran's nuclear programme and frozen funds.

squawks.headline: US Treasury yields rise after US data; 10-year up 5.36bp at 4.948%, 2-year up 3.13bp at 4.614%
squawks.detail: US Treasury yields moved higher after the release of US factory orders and JOLTS job openings data. The 10-year yield was last up 5.36bp at 4.948% and the 2-year was up 3.13bp at 4.614%.

squawks.headline: US September durable goods orders revised up to 1.9%, against a 1.8% forecast and initial reading
squawks.detail: The revised US durable goods orders figure for September is 1.9%. The forecast and the previous reading were both 1.8%.

squawks.headline: US factory orders rise 1.8% m/m, above the 1.2% forecast; revised core durable goods steady at 0.5%
squawks.detail: US factory orders rose 1.8% on the month, against a 1.2% forecast and 0.1% previously. Revised core durable goods orders came in at 0.5%, in line with the forecast and the previous reading.

squawks.headline: US JOLTS job openings rise to 7.523m in September, above the 7.164m forecast
squawks.detail: US job openings were 7,523K in September, against a forecast of 7,164K and 7,079K in the previous reading.

squawks.headline: ECB's Moulin calls France's 0.4% growth forecast optimistic and says a downgrade is likely
squawks.detail: ECB policymaker Moulin said France's 0.4% GDP growth forecast is optimistic and will probably need to be revised down. He described euro area growth as fairly resilient.

squawks.headline: Russia launches a large-scale attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure, hitting power plants and substations in nine regions
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that Russian missiles and drones struck power plants and substations across nine Ukrainian regions, and that Ukraine's air force struggled to intercept them. The attack comes ahead of the three-way talks in Abu Dhabi, where Ukraine has asked for an energy ceasefire to be discussed.

squawks.headline: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman says any understanding with the US requires a firm commitment to end the war on all fronts, including…
squawks.detail: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei also said Tehran is taking part in diplomacy with maximum caution because of past US breaches of agreements. Separately, security chief Rezaee repeated that the US response to Iran's seven conditions was not convincing.

squawks.headline: Iran's Rezaee says the US response falls short and Hormuz reopens only if Washington meets Iran's seven conditions
squawks.detail: Iranian official Rezaee said the US reply on Iran's demands was unconvincing. He said the Strait of Hormuz will reopen only once the US explicitly addresses and acts on Iran's seven conditions.

squawks.headline: UK moves ahead with its digital bond pilot and gives key roles to six banks
squawks.detail: A market news account reports that the UK has advanced its digital bond pilot and assigned key roles to six banks. The post did not name the banks or give a timetable.

squawks.headline: Russian crude exports climb to 3.65m b/d as attacks on its refineries resume
squawks.detail: A market news account reports that Russia's crude exports have risen to 3.65 million barrels a day amid renewed attacks on Russian refineries. No price reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Germany's Merz says third countries should not discuss Ukraine at the G20 meeting in Miami without Ukraine present
squawks.detail: German Chancellor Merz said it would be unacceptable for third countries to talk about Ukraine at the G20 meeting in Miami without Ukraine taking part.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy hopes US-mediated talks lead to a leaders' meeting and calls Russia's invitation to Moscow destructive
squawks.detail: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy said he hopes the US-mediated talks open the way to a meeting of leaders. He also described Russia's invitation for him to come to Moscow as destructive.

squawks.headline: US-Iran deal would be announced in stages with both sides acting at the same time, Al Araby reports
squawks.detail: Al Araby, citing sources close to the negotiating team, reported on how a US-Iran deal would be announced. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Germany's Merz says Russia must commit seriously to a ceasefire and a later peace agreement at the Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: German Chancellor Merz commented on the upcoming three-way Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Zelenskiy says Ukraine has offered Russia a longer, wider ceasefire and wants an energy ceasefire and Black Sea truce discussed in Abu Dhabi
squawks.detail: Ukraine's president said Kyiv had offered Russia an extended and expanded ceasefire after the humanitarian operation in Oleshky. He said a ceasefire on energy targets and a Black Sea truce should be discussed at the Abu Dhabi talks.

squawks.headline: US-Iran mediation turns to how to announce an interim deal: Iranian nuclear concession for release of some frozen funds, report says
squawks.detail: Al Araby, citing sources close to the mediators, reports that talks now focus on a first step and on how to announce an interim agreement, with both sides then returning to negotiations. Under the reported plan, Tehran would announce a concession on its nuclear programme and Washington would announce the release of part of Iran's frozen funds.

squawks.headline: Brent falls to $102 and European gas drops 8% to €86.9/MWh on reports of US-Iran concessions
squawks.detail: Brent and WTI futures turned negative and fell nearly 3% after President Trump said the US would stop paying Israel after year-end. Brent was then reported at $102 a barrel and European gas 8% lower at €86.9/MWh, as sources close to the mediators said Washington and Tehran had made concessions on nuclear issues and frozen assets.

squawks.headline: Trump says the US should pay the lowest interest rates in the world
squawks.detail: President Trump made the remark in a Fox News interview. Earlier in the same interview he said the US could balance its budget if the Fed cut rates.

squawks.headline: Germany's Merz says Russia risks further escalation with Black Sea attacks and a worldwide food crisis
squawks.detail: After talks with Ukraine's President Zelenskiy, German Chancellor Merz said Ukraine can continue to rely on Germany and that Russia risks further escalation with its Black Sea attacks. He also said a coalition of the willing summit will be held in Berlin later this month.

squawks.headline: US and Iran have made concessions on Tehran's nuclear programme and frozen funds, Al Araby Al Jadeed reports
squawks.detail: Al Araby Al Jadeed, citing unnamed sources, reports that Washington and Tehran have each made concessions on Iran's nuclear programme and its frozen funds. The two sides are reviewing the mediators' latest proposals.

squawks.headline: Trump says the US could balance its budget if the Fed cut interest rates
squawks.detail: Trump made the remarks in a Fox News interview, in which he also said Israel does not need the $4 billion in US aid.

squawks.headline: US approves Qatar's draft memorandum of understanding with Iran, and Saudi Arabia and UAE also back it, reports say
squawks.detail: Al Jazeera reports that Washington approved the draft MoU that the Qatari delegation presented for Iran yesterday. Sources close to the mediation team say Saudi Arabia and the UAE were briefed and approved it, and that the US and Iran made concessions on the nuclear file and frozen assets.

squawks.headline: Trump says the US successfully hit a recently built Iranian anti-aircraft facility overnight
squawks.detail: In a Fox News interview, the US president said the strike last night had worked, that he is not trying to cause mass casualties in Iran, but that the US would kill people there if it had to. He said Iran would see what happens after the elections.

squawks.headline: Trump says Canada will supply fertiliser to the US tariff-free and a broader deal with Canada is close
squawks.detail: Speaking in a Fox News interview, the US president said the US is close to a fertiliser deal with Canada and expects to reach a wider deal soon.

squawks.headline: Trump says the US is halting $4b of aid to Israel under a deal agreed months ago and will not raise payments
squawks.detail: US President Trump said in a Fox News interview that he would not increase payments to Israel and that a deal reached months ago means $4b of aid is being stopped. Asked about Iran after the elections, he said only that it remained to be seen.

squawks.headline: US Energy Secretary Wright says more refined products are coming out of the Arabian Gulf and India's output will rise
squawks.detail: US Energy Secretary Wright said refined product exports from the Arabian Gulf are increasing and that more refined output is expected from India. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: US Energy Secretary Wright says the overnight US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island have not affected oil flows
squawks.detail: US Energy Secretary Wright said the overnight US strikes on Iran, including the attack on Qeshm Island, have not affected the flow of oil.

squawks.headline: Kremlin's Peskov says Russia will in time need to talk to Europe about a future security system, but who it talks to matters
squawks.detail: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia would eventually have to discuss a future European security system with Europe, and stressed the importance of who its counterparts would be. He spoke ahead of the US-mediated three-way Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

squawks.headline: UK to make a guaranteed lifetime retirement income the default option for private sector pensions
squawks.detail: Plans unveiled by the UK government on Tuesday will make a guaranteed income for life the default retirement option for private sector workers, so that savers do not have to manage their pension pots themselves, Reuters reports.

squawks.headline: Brent crude drops below $105 a barrel to session lows
squawks.detail: Brent crude was reported trading below $105 a barrel, its lowest level of the session, while Iran and the US review the mediators' latest proposals.

squawks.headline: UK PM's spokesman rules out a return to EU freedom of movement during this parliament
squawks.detail: The Prime Minister's official spokesman said on Tuesday that the UK will not return to EU freedom of movement in the current parliament.

squawks.headline: Kremlin says security guarantees for both Russia and Ukraine will be on the table at the three-way Abu Dhabi talks
squawks.detail: Kremlin spokesman Peskov said security guarantees for Russia and Ukraine will be discussed at the three-way talks in Abu Dhabi. The talks are due on 10-11 November with US mediation.

squawks.headline: Iran's supreme leader warns foreign forces in the Persian Gulf that they belong only at the bottom of its waters
squawks.detail: Iran's supreme leader said in a statement that outside powers acting from thousands of kilometres away in the Gulf have no place there, as the US and Iran weigh Qatar's mediation proposals. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Qatari mediators expect US and Iranian responses to their new proposal within 36 hours
squawks.detail: An official briefed on the talks told Reuters that Qatar's mediators expect feedback from both Washington and Tehran within 36 hours on a new proposal intended to move the talks forward.

squawks.headline: Iran's president says the supreme leader has authorised talks on issues previously treated as non-negotiable
squawks.detail: Iran's president made the statement on Tuesday as Iran and the US consider the mediators' latest proposals. The report did not say which issues are covered or describe any market reaction.

squawks.headline: Resolution Foundation chief tells Treasury Committee the Budget's household living standards forecasts are dire
squawks.detail: Resolution Foundation chief executive Ruth Curtice gave evidence to the Treasury Select Committee on Tuesday morning about last week's Budget. She singled out the forecasts for household living standards as particularly bad.

squawks.headline: IFS director criticises the Budget's Founders Relief tax break for entrepreneurs at Treasury Committee hearing
squawks.detail: Helen Miller, head of the Institute for Fiscal Studies, told the Treasury Committee she did not see how Treasury officials could have concluded from the evidence on entrepreneurship that the Founders Relief tax break was good policy.

squawks.headline: Russia's Lavrov says reports of US strikes on Iran after the US vote have not been confirmed
squawks.detail: Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov said talk of US strikes on Iran after the US elections has not been confirmed, according to TASS.

squawks.headline: SNB's Schlegel says inflation pressure in September was slightly higher than in June and expects moderate Swiss growth
squawks.detail: Swiss National Bank Chairman Schlegel said inflation pressure in September was slightly higher than in June. He also said the Swiss economy should grow moderately after a strong second quarter.

squawks.headline: ECB's Moulin says the ECB has to stop inflation from spreading beyond energy
squawks.detail: ECB official Moulin said the central bank needs to keep energy-driven inflation from spilling over into wider prices. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: German 5-year Bobl auction clears at 3.14% with cover of 1.4, compared with 3.22% and 1.1 at the previous sale
squawks.detail: Germany's 5-year Bobl auction came in at an average yield of 3.14%, down from 3.22% at the previous sale. Bid-to-cover was 1.4, up from 1.1.

squawks.headline: Qatar says freedom of navigation is not up for negotiation and rejects threats to its carriers as US-Iran talks go on
squawks.detail: A spokesperson for Qatar's foreign ministry said Doha rejects any threat to Qatari carriers and others. The spokesperson also said Iran and the US remain committed to negotiations and that Qatar is working towards a deal that builds trust.

squawks.headline: Qatar reports progress in US-Iran mediation and says both sides are evaluating the proposal
squawks.detail: A spokesperson for Qatar's foreign ministry said the US and Iran are both committed to the mediation and are assessing the proposal, adding that Qatar remains hopeful of a deal that sets the stage for further negotiations. The spokesperson also said regional leaders are coordinating closely to find a solution and avoid escalation.

squawks.headline: Iranian state broadcaster says three oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday
squawks.detail: Iran's state broadcaster IRIB reported on Tuesday that three oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz. The report gave no cause, and no market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Qatar says its mediators are back in Doha from Tehran and US-Iran talks are continuing
squawks.detail: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesperson says the mediation team that went to Tehran on Monday night has returned, and both the US and Iran are reviewing the mediators' proposals. The spokesperson also says Gulf states agree on avoiding escalation.

squawks.headline: UK 10-year gilt auction clears at 5.268% with cover of 3.38, compared with 5.418% and 3.61 at the previous sale
squawks.detail: The 10-year gilt auction gave an average yield of 5.268%, down from 5.418% at the previous sale. The bid-to-cover ratio was 3.38, against 3.61 last time.

squawks.headline: China says it will keep a moderately loose monetary policy and sets out five focus areas for financial policy
squawks.detail: Xinhua reports that China will continue its moderately loose monetary policy and has named five main areas of focus for financial policy. These include stopping illegal financial activity and looking into the use of AI in financial oversight.

squawks.headline: Kazakhstan restarts oil flows through the Atyrau-Samara pipeline after drone attacks took it offline
squawks.detail: Kazakhstan's energy ministry said on Tuesday that it had resumed oil transit through the Atyrau-Samara pipeline, Reuters reports. Drone attacks had forced the pipeline to shut the previous day.

squawks.headline: Kremlin confirms three-way Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi next week, with Putin aide Medinsky leading Russia's delegation
squawks.detail: The Kremlin confirmed the tripartite talks on Ukraine due in Abu Dhabi next week and named presidential aide Vladimir Medinsky as Russia's lead negotiator. It said all sides broadly agree the meeting would be useful.

squawks.headline: Iran's Gharibabadi says Tehran would respond if a nuclear weapon were used against it
squawks.detail: Iranian official Gharibabadi told ISNA that Iran's hands would not be tied if it were the target of a nuclear weapon. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Iran says it would regard any action it takes as legitimate self-defence
squawks.detail: Iran says any action it takes would be legitimate self-defence. The statement comes as the US and Iran review mediators' proposals after US strikes on Qeshm Island. The report does not name the official who made it.

squawks.headline: ECB's Kocher says it is crucial to stop inflation becoming entrenched
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Martin Kocher said on Tuesday that the ECB must make sure inflation does not become entrenched.

squawks.headline: Iranian assessments increasingly see a return to war as likely, report says
squawks.detail: A newswire headline reports that assessments inside Iran increasingly see a return to war as likely. The report gives no source for the assessments and no market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Iran's president, parliament speaker and foreign minister press the military to engage with Qatar's proposal
squawks.detail: President Pezeshkian, parliament speaker Qalibaf and foreign minister Araqchi have urged Iran's armed forces to engage with the Qatari mediation proposal on a US-Iran deal. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: ECB's Machado calls for strong bank capital standards to be kept, including an output floor
squawks.detail: ECB official Machado said it is important to keep strong capital standards for banks and to retain an output floor. The remarks were about bank regulation, not interest rates.

squawks.headline: Iran's armed forces chief seeks recognition of Tehran's sovereignty over Hormuz and an end to the US security umbrella
squawks.detail: Further principles set out by Iran's armed forces chief, as reported by Tasnim and other outlets, include war reparations, guarantees against further aggression and security arrangements led from within the region. He also calls for recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and for the US security umbrella to be replaced.

squawks.headline: Iran's armed forces chief sets out five principles for regional peace, including an end to war on all fronts and full sanctions relief
squawks.detail: Iran's armed forces chief Abdollahi lists Tehran's conditions for a lasting regional peace, according to reports including Tasnim. They include an end to the war on all fronts, including Lebanon and Gaza, full sanctions relief and the release of frozen assets.

squawks.headline: Aramco CEO says global refining has lost 5m b/d of supply and tanker attacks have removed 15% of effective capacity
squawks.detail: Saudi Aramco's chief executive said the global refining market has lost 5m barrels a day of supply and that attacks on tankers have taken out 15% of effective capacity. He also said oil demand will recover more strongly.

squawks.headline: Aramco CEO warns energy markets face pressure this winter and says preliminary engineering on a pipeline expansion has begun
squawks.detail: Saudi Aramco's chief executive said energy markets will come under pressure in the coming winter. He added that the company has started preliminary engineering work on a pipeline expansion.

squawks.headline: German Chancellor Merz calls for a cut to electricity tax in the 2027 budget and says he has ideas on how to deliver it
squawks.detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said a reduction in electricity tax needs to be secured in Germany's 2027 budget. He did not say how it would be paid for.

squawks.headline: French year-to-date budget balance comes in at -159.173bn, compared with -159.60bn previously
squawks.detail: France's latest state budget balance figure is -159.173bn, against -159.60bn in the previous release. No forecast was given.

squawks.headline: Swiss October CPI rises 1.5% y/y, above the 1.2% forecast and up from 1.0%; core steady at 0.5%
squawks.detail: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.2% on the month, against a forecast of 0% and 0.0% previously. Core inflation was 0.5% y/y, in line with forecasts and unchanged from the previous reading.

squawks.headline: ECB's Radev says current rates are not adequate and the ECB should act without waiting for second-round effects
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Radev said core inflation is stable and the energy shock is not feeding through to wages, but argued that the ECB should move now rather than wait for second-round effects. He also said the economic environment is becoming increasingly difficult.

squawks.headline: ECB's Radev says the October pause does not mark the end of tightening as the economic environment becomes more challenging
squawks.detail: ECB Governing Council member Radev said the economic environment is getting more challenging and that the ECB's pause in October does not mean tightening has finished.

squawks.headline: US crude futures rise $2.14 to $98.60 a barrel as Iran and the US weigh mediators' latest proposals
squawks.detail: US oil futures are trading $2.14 higher at $98.60 a barrel in early trade. A diplomat says Tehran and Washington are reviewing new proposals from the mediators after Qatari officials held talks in Iran on Monday.

squawks.headline: Iran and the US are reviewing the mediators' latest proposals, a diplomat says
squawks.detail: A diplomat said both sides are studying the latest suggestions from mediators. The report follows Monday's talks in Tehran between Qatari mediators and Iran.

squawks.headline: Iran's foreign minister Araqchi says talks with Saudi Arabia on new regional security arrangements are continuing
squawks.detail: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on X on Tuesday that Tehran is in ongoing talks with Riyadh, seeking regional security arrangements without foreign military involvement, Reuters reports. Reuters also reports that fighting in Yemen is intensifying.

squawks.headline: Iran's parliament speaker Qalibaf says Tehran has sent Washington its response and the next move is for the US
squawks.detail: Iranian state media reported Parliament Speaker Qalibaf as saying Tehran had given the US a strong and rational response, leaving the next step to Washington. No market reaction was reported.

squawks.headline: Turkey's October CPI rises 29.77% y/y, above the 29.5% forecast, with prices up 2.58% on the month
squawks.detail: Turkish annual inflation came in at 29.77% against a 29.5% forecast and 29.73% previously. Monthly inflation was 2.58%, against a 2.4% forecast and 1.84% previously.

squawks.headline: Senior Iranian official says Tehran's conditions must be met before Hormuz reopens, with nuclear talks only to follow
squawks.detail: A senior Iranian official said Tehran will reject what it called excessive US demands and is ready to respond forcefully to any US strikes, in the region and beyond. The official added that mediators are working to narrow the gaps between Tehran and Washington.

squawks.headline: Aramco CEO says the company is looking at more export routes and overseas capacity, including a possible East-West pipeline expansion
squawks.detail: Saudi Aramco's chief executive said the company is exploring additional export routes and capacity abroad, among them a potential expansion of its East-West pipeline. No timing or volumes were given.

squawks.headline: China halts IPOs and share offerings in a bid to stabilise weak markets, FT reports
squawks.detail: The Financial Times reports that China's securities regulator has privately told investment banks in recent days to pause initial public offerings.

squawks.headline: IEA says global LNG supply could post a record annual decline because of the Iran war
squawks.detail: The International Energy Agency said the Iran war could cause global liquefied natural gas supply to fall by a record amount this year, the WSJ reports.

squawks.headline: RBA's Bullock says it is unclear how high rates may need to go and no decision has been made on further hikes
squawks.detail: The RBA Governor said the latest hike may not be enough but further increases are not clearly needed, and that unemployment remains relatively low and she does not see the economy weakening. The Australian dollar was reported near a two-week low after the decision, which took the cash rate to an 18-year high in the fifth hike of the year.

squawks.headline: RBA's Bullock gives no guidance on the next move after the hike and says pausing to assess incoming data is probably best
squawks.detail: At her press conference after the rate rise, the RBA Governor said the increase was needed to bring inflation down, that growth must stay subdued and unemployment rise further, and that she sees no wage-price spiral. She said board members who favoured a hold were not ruling out higher rates and that this hike might not be enough; Reuters reported the Australian dollar dipped after the decision.

squawks.headline: Washington calls its Qeshm Island strikes defensive, aimed at protecting US military assets in the Middle East
squawks.detail: The FT reports the US described Monday night's strikes on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz as a defensive move, and says the attacks appear limited in scope.

squawks.headline: RBA raises cash rate 25bp to 4.85% in 6-3 vote, citing a material upward revision to its inflation outlook
squawks.detail: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its rate from 4.60%, as forecast. Three board members preferred no change. Staff forecasts put CPI at 4.5% and trimmed mean CPI at 3.6% in Q4 2026, and the Australian dollar fell 0.35% to $0.6974 after the decision.

squawks.headline: Oil rises in early Asian trade after report of US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, then stabilises
squawks.detail: Reuters reported oil prices rising in early Asian trading on Tuesday after the Wall Street Journal said the US had struck Qeshm Island. A later Reuters report said oil had stabilised after the previous session's sharp fall, with Asian stocks lower ahead of the US midterm elections.

squawks.headline: Offshore yuan falls as much as 0.34% to 6.67 per dollar after PBOC raises FX deposit reserve ratio
squawks.detail: The offshore yuan fell 0.26% to 6.6642 per dollar, its largest daily drop since June, before extending losses to 0.34% at 6.67. The move followed the PBOC's increase in the foreign currency deposit reserve ratio to 6% from 4%. The PBOC fixed the yuan midpoint at 6.7150 per dollar.

squawks.headline: PBOC raises the foreign exchange deposit reserve ratio to 6% from 4%, effective 15 November
squawks.detail: The People's Bank of China says the 2-percentage-point increase is intended to improve the management of foreign currency liquidity at financial institutions.

squawks.headline: US military carries out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, WSJ reports
squawks.detail: The Wall Street Journal reports that the US has launched strikes against Iran's Qeshm Island. No market reaction was reported in the posts.

squawks.headline: US to mediate Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on 10-11 November covering an end to the war and post-war security
squawks.detail: US envoy Witkoff and a senior US official say the working-level trilateral talks will cover ending the war, post-war security pacts, de-escalation and aid measures. US negotiators will also meet France, Germany, the UK, the EU and NATO in Brussels this week.

squawks.headline: South Korea's October CPI rises 2.8% y/y, in line with forecasts and down from 2.9%
squawks.detail: The statistics office says prices rose 0.2% on the month, below the poll, and core CPI rose 2.8% y/y.

squawks.headline: Iranian state media reports five explosions on Qeshm Island as the IRGC claims it downed an MQ-9 drone east of Hormuz
squawks.detail: Iran's IRNA news agency reported five explosions on Qeshm Island and said their intensity suggested impacts on the island. Shortly before, Iran's IRGC claimed it had shot down an MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz with an advanced air defence system; neither report gave a source for the explosions or any market reaction.

squawks.headline: Trump says Iran wants a settlement as soon as possible and that one could happen, as oil falls almost $10 a barrel
squawks.detail: In a social media post, US President Trump said oil prices had dropped almost $10 a barrel because people expect there will be no war with Iran. He added that Iran wants a settlement as soon as possible.

squawks.headline: US Treasury puts its fourth-quarter borrowing estimate at $618bn, $10bn below its August projection
squawks.detail: Reuters reports that the US Treasury now expects to borrow $618bn in the fourth quarter, $10bn less than it projected in August. The Treasury attributed the cut to a higher-than-assumed starting cash balance, partly offset by lower projected net cash flows.

squawks.headline: US VP Vance says progress has been made towards an Iran deal and no deadline has been set for resuming strikes
squawks.detail: US Vice President Vance said he feels good about the prospects of a deal with Iran, that there have been a number of good talks with Iranian officials and that some progress has been made. He also said the US has not set any deadlines for resuming strikes.

squawks.headline: US Treasury expects $628bn of borrowing for October-December 2026, assuming an $850bn end-December cash balance
squawks.detail: The US Treasury published the estimate in its quarterly refunding release. The same release put privately held net marketable borrowing at $739bn, which it said was $68bn higher than the May projection, mainly because it now expects lower net cash flows.

squawks.headline: Trump answers no when asked whether the US will strike Iran after the elections
squawks.detail: US President Trump said no when asked about striking Iran after the elections, according to a White House pool report.

squawks.headline: US Treasury puts privately held net marketable borrowing at $739bn in its quarterly refunding estimate
squawks.detail: The US Treasury's quarterly refunding estimate puts privately held net marketable borrowing at $739bn for the July-September 2026 quarter, assuming an end-September cash balance of $950bn. Excluding a higher-than-expected cash balance at the start of the quarter, the estimate is $87bn above the May projection.

squawks.headline: Trump says an Iran deal is coming together well, which is why oil is falling, and that the US will stop killing Iran's leaders as asked
squawks.detail: Speaking at the Reflecting Pool, President Trump said Iran had asked the US to stop killing its leaders and that the US would do so. He said things with Iran were coming together well and linked this to the fall in oil.

squawks.headline: Brent crude futures settle down $8.66, or 7.63%, at $104.77 a barrel
squawks.detail: Brent settles at $104.77 a barrel, down $8.66 or 7.63% on the day, amid hopes of a deal to end the Iran war.

squawks.headline: Trump tells Axios he is in no hurry to decide whether to restart the war with Iran
squawks.detail: In a phone interview with Axios, the US President said he did not need to decide quickly on resuming the war with Iran. He also said Iran had recently stated again that it will not have a nuclear weapon.

squawks.headline: Trump says oil will fall further because the US is winning with Iran, and a deal could happen
squawks.detail: US President Trump said oil prices will go down further, that Iran wants to make a deal which could happen, and that Iran has said recently it will not have a nuclear weapon.

squawks.headline: WTI December crude settles down $7.66, or 7.36%, at $96.46 a barrel
squawks.detail: NYMEX WTI December futures settled at $96.46 a barrel, down $7.66 or 7.36%. December gasoline settled at $2.9001 a gallon, diesel at $4.4216 a gallon and natural gas at $2.8560/MMBtu.

squawks.headline: Qatari mediators head to Tehran for talks with Iran's foreign minister on a draft US-Iran deal
squawks.detail: An official briefed on the talks told Reuters that Qatari mediators were travelling to Tehran late on Monday to meet Foreign Minister Araghchi. The official said the talks would cover a version of a draft US-Iran deal that has been under negotiation for the past eight days.

squawks.headline: UK reportedly ready to pay up to £450m a year on EU student fees in return for equal treatment under EU 'Made in Europe' plan
squawks.detail: A report says the UK would spend up to £450m a year on fees for EU students if Brussels gives British companies equal treatment under its planned 'Made in Europe' industrial programme. The report gave no source for the UK position.

squawks.headline: Iran's Fars News, citing a source, says there is no new development in message exchanges with the US
squawks.detail: A source quoted by Fars News Agency said exchanges with the US through intermediaries are routine and there will be no new steps until the US meets Iran's seven conditions. The source also said the Strait of Hormuz is under Iran's full military control.

squawks.headline: US Treasury yields fall to their lowest since 10 September, with the 10-year down 5.76bp at 4.871%
squawks.detail: Market reports show US Treasury yields at their lowest level since 10 September. The 10-year note yield was last 5.76bp lower on the day at 4.871%.

squawks.headline: Israel says it will back whatever the US decides on Iran and that a nuclear strike is not under discussion
squawks.detail: Israel's UN envoy Danon told Al Arabiya that Israel will support the US decision on Iran, and that Israel and the US are not discussing a nuclear strike on Iran.

squawks.headline: Brent's fall widens to more than $9 a barrel and WTI drops $8 on hopes of a deal to end the Iran war
squawks.detail: Oil futures fell further late on Monday, with Brent down by more than $9 a barrel and US WTI down $8. The moves were reported as driven by hopes of a deal to end the Iran war.

squawks.headline: US-Iran talks reach a breakthrough after Qatari mediation clears procedural hurdles, Al-Jadeed reports
squawks.detail: Lebanese broadcaster Al-Jadeed, citing diplomatic sources, reports that Qatari mediation overcame procedural obstacles in the US-Iranian negotiations. No official confirmation or market reaction has been reported.
